description: RC2.3.9 — every release invariant has exactly ONE canonical owner (a package.json script that runs in a canonical suite). secondaryEvidence may overlap; owner may not. Checked by gate:rc2-3-9-stack-convergence (INVARIANT_OWNERSHIP).

FIXED_SPEECH_CANONICAL_VOICE.statement: Mandarin speech always uses the canonical fixed voice (recorded asset first, TTS only as fallback); no per-surface voice drift.

AUDIO_SINGLE_AUTHORITY.statement: One audio arbiter owns playback; no second audio engine, no overlapping voices.

LESSON_PROGRESSION_NON_BLOCKING.statement: Audio, speech or observers never block the learner from advancing (fail-open, observer never blocks action).

TEACH_BEFORE_TEST.statement: Every graded task is preceded by teaching/exposure of its target across the whole Journey.

CULTURE_TEACH_BEFORE_TEST.statement: Culture lessons teach before they assess.

CURRICULUM_LEAK.statement: No vocabulary/target from a future lesson is assessed or recommended before it is introduced.

PEDAGOGY_V6_PASS_BUDGETS.statement: Discovery → Fixation → Use → Mastery with pass budgets P1 7–9, P2 8–11, P3 10–13, P4 12–15.

VISUAL_FIRST_ASSOCIATION.statement: Visual-first images map to the taught concept; abstract concepts never get a misleading picture.

HANZI_WRITING_ELIGIBILITY.statement: NOT_INTRODUCED → INTRODUCED_NO_WRITING_DATA → TRACE_ELIGIBLE → MEMORY_ELIGIBLE → PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE; no graded writing for an untaught character.

SPEECH_TECHNICAL_FAILURE_NON_PENALTY.statement: ASR/mic/network failure never becomes a learner failure; ASR is not a tone grader; recordings stay local and temporary.

PERSONAL_MASTERY_EVIDENCE_SEMANTICS.statement: Evidence Record semantics (dimensions, independence, spacing, variety, SRS decay, UNKNOWN ≠ WEAK); mastery only prioritises practice, never Journey eligibility.

GUIDANCE_BUDGET_AND_SENSORY.statement: Guidance surfaces are real routes, respect the orchestrator budget; haptics/sound follow the sensory contract.

ACCOUNT_ISOLATION.statement: Canonical identity is the Supabase user id; storage is namespaced local / cloud:<uid>; logout/switch never leaks another account's data.

PROGRESS_CLAIM_LOSSLESS.statement: Local progress claim is idempotent (claim ledger), never last-write-wins, per-field economy policy, evidence deduped by stable id, mastery re-derived.

OAUTH_REDIRECT_SAFETY.statement: PKCE, redirect allowlist, internal-only return routes, single-flight callback.

ENTITLEMENT_SERVER_AUTHORITY.statement: Pro/entitlements are decided server-side only; never persisted or claimed from the client.

NO_SECRETS_IN_CLIENT.statement: No service_role key, OAuth client secret or provider token ships in src/dist/Android assets.

JEV_RUNTIME_DISABLED.statement: Jev never runs in the learner runtime (JEV_RUNTIME_ENABLED=false); only server-side triage and DEV_AUDIT.

RELEASE_FINGERPRINT_CHAIN.statement: The curriculum fingerprint only advances through typed EXPECTED_FINGERPRINT_ADVANCE records from one shared anchor; every validator reads the same chain.

ANDROID_NATIVE_CONTRACT.statement: Capacitor platform boundaries, signing contract and native foundation stay intact.

CULTURE_CONTENT_TRUTH.statement: Culture content is sourced, history vs legend separated, festival dates follow policy, no lexical pollution.

PRODUCT_TRUTH_HONEST.statement: docs/release/product-truth.json is generated, fresh, uses the single status vocabulary and never reports PASS for unconfigured/unrun items.

CANONICAL_GATE_COVERAGE.statement: Every legacy validate:beta step still runs in exactly one canonical suite or is retired with recorded equivalence; no hidden skips on release gates.
